game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter, a smelter processing glowing ore: the lava scout must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the lava scout's power beats the shield shown by cinder bats.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter: a smelter processing glowing ore
core_gameplay_loop: In Ore Smelter, repeat each round: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the lava scout's power beats the shield shown by cinder bats. Each round, a new heat shields challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the power value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 260 points of heat shields by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 260, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 5 (applied tier): Comparison Duel
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Ore Smelter.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 260 within 42 seconds.
